title: Binary Cube Encryption Laboratory Tool Projection
description: Portable structured-tool projection for the Binary Cube laboratory. It describes calls into canonical laboratory modules and does not implement encryption logic or provide a remote RPC service.

protocolMappings.openaiFunctionTools: Expose each entry in tools as a function tool using its name, description, and inputSchema; bind execution to the named local module and method.
protocolMappings.mcp: Expose each entry in tools as an MCP tool using inputSchema; bind execution locally to the named module and method. This descriptor is not itself an MCP server.
protocolMappings.genericJsonTool: Use the tool name and inputSchema, then dispatch to the declared binding module/method.

tools.name: binary_cube_describe
tools.description: Describe the Binary Cube laboratory, runtime, security classification, discovery facilities, high-level workflows, validation protocol, and callable operation names.

tools.name: binary_cube_list_operations
tools.description: List every low-level callable Binary Cube operation together with its canonical positional arguments and return contract.

tools.name: binary_cube_operation_contract
tools.description: Return the canonical argument and return contract for one low-level Binary Cube operation before constructing an invocation.

tools.name: binary_cube_invoke
tools.description: Invoke one documented low-level Binary Cube operation through the canonical adapter.

tools.name: binary_cube_encrypt
tools.description: High-level workflow: validate or create a key, encrypt a binary payload, validate the canonical package, and return separate key and package.

tools.name: binary_cube_decrypt
tools.description: High-level workflow: validate a separate canonical key and package, decrypt through the canonical engine, and return recovered bits.

tools.name: binary_cube_list_test_packages
tools.description: List deterministic positive test packages and negative validator-layer packages for the three-state validation protocol.

tools.name: binary_cube_validate_three_state
tools.description: Run the three-state protocol for one registered/custom package or the complete suite.

tools.name: binary_cube_strength_analysis
tools.description: Measure one-bit plaintext perturbation diffusion, deterministic key-seed perturbation diffusion, and localized gridSize^2 diagnostic-window diffusion. Reports weaknesses; it does not claim production cryptographic security.

tools.name: binary_cube_self_test
tools.description: Run deterministic Binary Cube portable acceptance tests in the current Node/CommonJS host.

adoption.notes: Prefer high-level encrypt/decrypt for ordinary use. Use three-state validation for correctness and validator faults. Use strength analysis to search for diffusion weaknesses, including localized diagnostic windows. None of these results establishes production cryptographic security.
